author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Valid geometry but NOT approved visually: at 48 the two side ring heads beside the capped head and the flat shoulder line read as a frowning face wearing a mortarboard. Five layouts tried (U head + r3/r4 side heads on HRECT_L, three heads in a row with the cap on a round head, classmates behind at the upper corners on SQUARE); all read as a face or broke 8-unit clearance.
omissions: Cannot-fix: three busts plus a mortarboard need about 44 units of height at 8-unit spacing (cap 10, head 8, gap 8, shoulders >=8, side heads >=8 from the graduate head); HRECT_L gives 32 and SQUARE 36 with no room for the side people.
